label: scam
title: Fake bank fraud call that steals a one-time code (contrast with the legit bank call)

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, this is Mark from the security team at First Valley Bank. Is this Robert Chen?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Robert, someone is trying to take money out of your checking account right now. I need to move quickly to stop it.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: They're trying to wire two thousand dollars overseas. I can freeze your account, but I need to verify that you're the real owner.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Okay, how do I do that?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: We just texted a six digit verification code to your phone. Please read me that code right now so I can stop the transfer.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: The text says the bank will never ask for this code.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: That message is for other situations. This is an emergency, sir. If you don't read me the code in the next minute, the money is gone.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I don't know. This doesn't feel right.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Please, sir, don't hang up, and don't call the branch, they can't help with this. Just read me the code.
